title: Rollout Compatibility Advisor and Safety Playbook for Structured Outputs
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Build a lightweight Rollout Compatibility Advisor that combines schema validation, function-call diff heuristics, and signal fusion to drive safe canary/A-B/shadow rollouts for structured outputs and tool-calling. Deliver a documented safety playbook and automated gating knobs so PMs/SEs can opt into probabilistic or deterministic rollouts with auto-rollback policies. This ticket covers design, MVP implementation, monitoring dashboards, and a runbook for incident handling. Motivations: recent migrations showed surface-level parity checks missed subtle type/semantics shifts and caused downstream tool errors. We need a richer advisor that correlates structured-output drift with downstream tool failures and latency/cost regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Advisor produces a compatibility score (0-100) per model variant that combines schema conformance, function-call argument diffs, and downstream invocation success rate.
Canary policy can be configured to block or auto-unwind a rollout if score falls below configurable thresholds within a 30m observation window.
Dashboard shows per-slice metrics (route, model-version, customer-tier) and links to top-10 offending examples.
Automated playbook: when threshold breached, system triggers a staged rollback (soft traffic freeze, then full rollback) and creates an incident with pre-filled diagnostics.
E2E integration tests that simulate schema-breaking, schema-widening, and argument-type-misinterpretation cases pass and the advisor triggers expected mitigations.
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (design): define compatibility score components and thresholds; document playbook; align with PM/Design on UX for console flags.
Phase 2 (MVP): implement server-side compatibility scorer, lightweight shadow sink for tool-call success/failure logging, and a canary controller that reads score and applies policy.
Phase 3 (observability): add dashboard tiles, alert rules, and example breadcrumbs linking model input, output, and invoked-tool responses.
Phase 4 (hardening): add probabilistic smoothing, false-positive reduction heuristics, and automated PRs for rollout-policy updates when safe patterns observed.
Phase 5 (docs/runbook): publish playbook, runbooks, and training notes for SE/Oncall.
rollout_plan: Start with internal-only routes: shadow rollout + scoring for 48h to gather baseline distributions.
Enable 0.5% canary traffic for 6h with strict scoring (block if score < 85).
Increase to 5% for 12h with relaxed scoring (block if score < 75) and synthetic probes for edge-case inputs.
A/B experiments limited to non-critical customers first; require manual approval from PM for >10% traffic.
Auto-rollback strategy: soft-freeze (stop scaling new variant) -> redirect new requests to previous variant -> escalate to full rollback if score doesn't recover in 30m.
metrics_and_alerts: Compatibility score: aggregated hourly + 5m window for alerts (alert if delta > 10 vs baseline).
Function-call error rate: tag by tool and argument position (alert if absolute error rate increase > 0.5%).
Downstream latency spike correlated with schema drift (alert when p95 latency for tool calls increases by >20%).
Top-10 example diffs and golden-output divergence rate for structured fields.
test_plan: Unit tests for scorer components (schema conformance, diff heuristics, signal fusion).
Integration tests: synthetic tool simulators that return controlled successes/failures to validate gating logic.
Shadow-run harness: ingest production traffic (scrubbed) and validate score distribution matches historical expectations.
Chaos test: simulate partial telemetry loss and ensure advisor degrades to conservative blocking policy.
rollback_conditions: Compatibility score below configured threshold for the model-route-slice for >30 minutes.
Unrelated increase in downstream tool exceptions that correlates with new variant (>0.5% absolute increase and >2x relative).
p95 token generation latency regressions >50ms with concurrent increase in cost-per-token >10%.
Manual abort by oncall/PM after reviewing top diffs and dashboard.
